summary: V3-08 repair candidate accepted. The candidate is a non-empty delta (changedFiles=2, hasDelta=true, verificationOnly=false, agentExitCode=0) repairing the trusted finalizer step-7 blocker of Actions run 35485115705 within Builder scope: scripts/e2e-android.js and __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts only. The failure chain is documented across the previous accepted cycles: the emulator step (Android API 35 install/launch/golden path) fails after ~22 min with boot and install succeeding, while uiautomator dumps take 30-60s each under React Native cold-start load and exhaust the waitFor windows. The previous cycle's 2s-TTL dump cache was explicitly identified as inert (TTL < dump duration, so every findNodes call triggered a fresh 30-60s dump). This candidate repairs exactly that mechanism: (1) DUMP_CACHE_TTL_MS 2000 -> 30000 so same-screen rapid calls (assertAbsent batches, screenshot + findVisible, sequential waitFor) share one dump; (2) the cache is invalidated on tapNode and swipeUp so post-transition calls always get a fresh dump of the new screen state (all golden-path screen transitions go through tapLabel/swipeUp, so no stale reads are possible in the exercised path); (3) the dumpsys activity pre-check in launch() is reduced from 12 iterations (60s) to 3 (15s), saving up to 45s of dead time before the Demarrer window; (4) all golden-path waitFor windows are widened to >= 60s (Demarrer 480s->600s; tabs, Vaisselle du soir, Alex, Sam, Contribution, Sortir les poubelles 10-30s -> 120s) so each window fits 1-2 full dump attempts. Failed dumps are never cached (cache set only on successful dumps), so waitFor retries with fresh dumps on failure. Three new static contract tests guard the repair: TTL >= 15s with tap/swipe invalidation, all golden-path waitFor timeouts >= 60s, and dumpsys pre-check bounded to <= 20s. Trusted verification passed exit 0: typecheck, 435 tests (22 suites), privacy 71 tests, cost 21 tests (10 gates), expo install --check up to date, expo export android, prebuild, :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 18m59s. Independent re-run: 435/435 tests PASS, wrapper contract 9/9 PASS, privacy PASS, cost PASS, node --check PASS, bash -n PASS, candidate.patch byte-identical to staged diff, pristine diff limited to the 2 candidate files. No product code, governance, directives, docs or workflow files changed; no chrono/premium/paywall/warm-V2 reintroduction; no cost regression (CI-script-only delta). Empirical confirmation of the emulator fix remains with the next trusted finalizer run.

findings.problem: typeInto(), back() and swipeToTop() do not invalidate the dump cache, so with the 30s TTL they can read stale UI state after a screen change (e.g. typeInto's 3s verification loop would read the pre-typing text from the cache and fail). These functions are defined but not called anywhere in the current golden path, so the exercised E2E is unaffected.
findings.evidence: grep confirms typeInto/inputKeyText/back/swipeToTop are only defined (lines 277, 318, 329, 344) and never invoked in the golden path (lines 524-664); the golden path's only screen transitions are tapLabel (invalidates via tapNode) and swipeUp (invalidates).
findings.requiredFix: None for this cycle: the current golden path cannot hit a stale cache. If a future golden-path step adds typing, back-navigation or swipeToTop, those functions must invalidate _dumpCache the same way tapNode/swipeUp do.
